description: Implement the minimal website bootstrap accepted by bitty-docs CTX-0009 after that docs task is completed. description: Publish the reviewed repository foundation as the initial main-branch snapshot. This is the documented unborn-repository bootstrap exception: no branch, worktree, pull request, or GitHub Issue can precede the first commit. Audit the exact untracked file set and ignored files; run CI-equivalent local checks; independently review scope, generated artifacts, local databases, credentials, secret values, and accidental product implementation. After independent acceptance, create one coherent initial commit directly on main and push it to the canonical origin with upstream tracking. Verify the remote branch SHA and GitHub default branch, then monitor automatically triggered CI when configured. Do not force-push, create tags or releases, invoke deployment, read secret values, or make content changes outside a separately authorized task.
title: Publish the initial website snapshot

description:
## Mission
Add repository governance and toolchain scaffolding files to THIS repository, mirroring the structure and spirit of the reference repository `***REDACTED-PATH***`.

## Files to add (brand-new only)
- LICENSE - MIT license text mirroring the reference repo, holder line adapted to the Bitty project ("Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitty Terminal Contributors" style - match the exact phrasing style used by the reference LICENSE).
- CONTRIBUTING.md - adapt the reference: development setup, Conventional Commits expectation, delivery lifecycle Issue -> Branch -> Commit -> PR -> Review -> Merge, pointer to AGENTS.md and justfile quality gates.
- SECURITY.md - supported versions section marked unreleased, private vulnerability reporting via GitHub Security Advisories, disclosure policy and response expectations.
- CHANGELOG.md - Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 format with only an "## [Unreleased]" section.
- commitlint.config.ts - mirror the reference conventional-commits configuration.
- .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc - mirror the reference markdownlint-cli2 configuration (ignore globs for node_modules, target, dist, build, site).
## Hard constraints
- First inspect the repo with `ls -la`: SKIP any matrix file that already exists and record that fact instead of overwriting.
- DO NOT modify ANY existing file (no AGENTS.md, README.md, justfile, package.json, wrangler.jsonc edits). Tooling wiring proposals (lefthook, just targets, CI workflows) go into a progress note as recommendations for a follow-up post-initialization task.
- No commits, no pushes, no remote/git state changes. Git write operations are NOT authorized for this task.
- If main becomes born mid-task (another agent pushed the initial snapshot), stop adding files immediately, record what is complete, review + hand off.
- English-only content. Describe files as proposed scaffolding, never as implemented product behavior.
- The reference repo is READ-ONLY evidence: do not execute, build, install, or copy anything from it beyond adapting the listed governance files.

## Verification
- Every matrix file either present or explicitly skipped-because-exists.
- Links inside CONTRIBUTING.md/SECURITY.md resolve within this repository.
- CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog headings; commitlint.config.ts is syntactically plausible TypeScript (visual check only, no installs).
- One progress note per nontrivial decision; list final added/skipped set in the last note.

## Closure
- Progress notes -> checkpoint -> `task review` (stop at IN_REVIEW; NEVER complete the task yourself).
- Handoff HO addressed to commander `opencode` summarizing added files, skipped files, and wiring recommendations.
title: Add governance and toolchain scaffolding files

Priority: P1 | Area: website | Labels: feat,area:website,P1 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-023 | Task: CTX-0081

Implements Website Delivery RFC (OQ-023, bitty-docs CTX-0079 Accepted 2026-08-29) in bitty-website:

- Pinned docs revision: src/content/docs-revision.json single source of truth ({revision, source, synced_at}), no floating main, stale-mirror rejection.
- Loader: Astro content collection src/content/config.ts with strict 8-field z.object schema mirroring Documentation workflow (title==H1, category/audience/document_type/status enums, website_publish bool, sidebar_order int), validation before filtering, language gate (CJK), link integrity, non-duplication.
- Route mapping: deterministic docs/<category>/<path>.md -> /docs/<version>/<category>/<slug>/ with README index handling, collision-checked, single module src/lib/docsRoutes.ts.
- Multi-version URL scheme: /docs/<version>/<path>/ with latest/stable aliases, /docs -> 301 /docs/latest/, version isolation in dist.
- Version selector: data-driven from src/content/versions.json (SemVer descending, latest/stable), navigator rewriting version segment only.
- Redirect manifest: split ownership — bitty-docs docs/project/redirects.json intent merged with src/redirects.json implementation into Astro redirects + Cloudflare _redirects, validation rejects loops/chains/missing targets/wildcards.

Docs remain source of truth; no verbatim copy outside src/content/docs mirror. Validate via just check + act -n. Leave dirty, record carryctx.

Counterpart to bitty-docs CTX-0081 (ADR 0006 os.getenv) numbering collision; website task will allocate next sequence number and record mapping.

description:
Discovered during CTX-0017: relative Markdown links and non-Markdown asset references in the mirrored corpus render unchanged, so e.g. [x](../foo/bar.md) becomes a broken href on the website. MV-4 requires resolving relative links/assets against the rendered versioned route. Additionally, scripts/lib/docs-routes.mjs (used by sync/check) and src/lib/docsRoutes.ts disagree with the Astro renderer on nested README/index handling (RM-6 drift); docsRoutes.ts also throws on docs/<category>/<dir>/README.md. Unify on one mapper that matches the renderer, add the fixture + negative collision tests required by the RFC, and implement version-aware rewriting for links and images at render time. Evidence: 1631 relative .md links and 58 asset refs across 71 publishable docs at the CTX-0017 pin.

Priority: P1 | Area: docs-infra | Labels: fix,area:website,P1 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-023 | Task: CTX-0018
title: fix(docs): version-aware link and asset rewriting; reconcile route mapper with renderer
